title: You don't need to look rich to be wealthy

motionTheme.name: Clear thinking
motionTheme.rationale: Mindset topic: clean, fast settles with gold anchors keep the focus on the idea, not the effects.

brief.hook: The easiest way to look rich is by spending the money you should have used to become wealthy.
keep: If you spend whatever is left over, the gap between what you make and what you spend gets smaller so you can do less with it. If you let that gap get really big, you can make that money work multiple times over for you.
You work to trade your time for money first, then you build assets that buy back your time, so if you're not working, you're still making money. That's the goal.
brief.onScreenText: Looking rich is how you stay broke

exampleHooks: If you can master this one mindset shift, you will be in the 1%.
30k a month is pathetic and I don't mean to say this in a way that's genuinely derogatory towards anyone making 30k a month but
just watch the Odyssey and there's one scene I can't stop thinking about.
